item.title: 350 years ago, Ole Rømer discovered that light has a finite speed
item.description:
📝 350 years ago, this man discovered that light has a finite speed Ole Rømer was the first to demonstrate that light takes time to travel. Rømer demonstrated that light does not travel infinitely fast, says Linder. Rømer concluded that light took approximately 22 minutes to cross the diameter of Earth's orbit, says Linder.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencenorway.no/culture-history-history-of-science/350-years-ago-this-man-discovered-that-light-has-a-finite-speed/2737969

item.title: Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review
item.description:
📝 Editor’s Note: Engineers at firms that adopted AI coding agents added about 30 percent more code, yet finished work did not measurably rise and getting code through review took 49 percent longer, according to a working paper by Harvard Ph. " News Analysis – Artificial Intelligence Beat Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review ComplexDiscovery OÜ Staff Engineers at firms that adopted AI coding agents added about 30 percent more code, but finished work did not measurably rise and getting code through review took 49 percent longer, a Harvard working paper found. They acknowledge one known imbalance, that larger firms adopted earlier, and they control for firm size.
